# T-1: Add WorkUnit primitives

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce reusable WorkUnit identity, checkpoint, store, and resume decision classes for AI provider call checkpoints.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 and R2 are represented by dedicated classes with constructor validation and a stable `unitId` lookup separate from full identity.
- Checkpoint serialization and identity equality are covered by spec-local unit tests.
- No external dependency is added.

## Implementation Notes
Place foundation code under `src/flow/lib/` and keep it independent of impl-gate, draft-review, spec-review, and test-review. Use sha256 from Node.js `crypto` for identity digests.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests cover identity field changes, stable `unitId`, exact-match reuse decisions, stale decisions, checkpoint serialization, and failure status validation.
